resources.string: BurnPony turns a private message into a one-time link. When the views run out or the clock runs down, the note is deleted from the relay and nobody can bring it back.
Your note is encrypted on this device with AES-256-GCM. The key travels only in the part of the link after the #, which browsers never send to any server. The relay stores ciphertext it cannot read.
Choose how many views it allows and when it expires. Add auto-hide so the text disappears again seconds after it is revealed, or a passphrase you share through a different channel than the link.
Not a demo. Tap below and BurnPony will encrypt a real note and give you a real link — one view, five minutes. Send it to yourself and watch it burn.
Creates a real note: one view, expires in five minutes.
It is waiting for you in Sent Notes.
Watch it, or burn it early
Sent Notes shows which notes are still alive, how many views are left and when each one expires. You can burn any note early, and read receipts tell you the moment one is opened.
Honest limits: whoever has the full link can read the note, and a reader can always photograph what is on screen. Self-destruction limits future access; it does not control the moment of reading.
Write something you would not want sitting in a chat history. It gets encrypted on this device before anything is uploaded.
Fixed for this first note so you can watch it burn. Every note you send after this one is yours to configure.
Six slides, including sending a note.
